issues.where: nearly the entire Mars surface and dust storm outside central Valles Marineris (image-06.png crops B, C, D, E, H, I; image-07.png crops J, K, L, M, N, O, R; image-08.png crops S, T, U, V, W, X)
issues.what: roughly 80% of the visible globe surface and cloud layer is blurry, upscaled, and airbrushed-looking at native size because the base planetary texture lacks resolution for this close camera distance
issues.fix: use higher-resolution spherical albedo, displacement, and cloud maps or procedural detail tiles across the entire visible hemisphere so every surface crop resolves crisply at 1:1

issues.where: margins around central Valles Marineris (image-06.png crops A, F, G; image-07.png crops O, P, Q)
issues.what: visible borders of a localized high-resolution detail patch over central Valles Marineris where crisp micro-relief abruptly drops off into soft, low-resolution surrounding terrain
issues.fix: extend uniform high-frequency terrain and normal-map detail across the full visible surface and seamlessly blend multi-resolution tile boundaries so no patch edge is visible

issues.where: eastern Valles Marineris and outer corners (image-06.png crops E, H, I; image-07.png crop R; image-08.png crops S, W, X)
issues.what: heavy directional texture stretching, radial smearing, and cyan-red color fringing turn the canyon walls and outer terrain into blurry streaks
issues.fix: remove radial edge blur and chromatic aberration post-effects, check UV projection and displacement at oblique angles, and maintain crisp full-resolution detail out to the frame edges

issues.where: upper-right limb (image-07.png crops M and N)
issues.what: a doubled edge and dark concentric gap separate a floating outer haze/cloud shell from the planet surface, with noisy jagged pixels along the outer shell rim
issues.fix: replace the offset shell layer with a continuous volumetric atmosphere anchored to the planetary surface and anti-alias the grazing limb

issues.where: foreground moon Phobos and its large right-side crater (image-02.png crop G; image-03.png crops P, Q; image-04.png crop V)
issues.what: the moon surface looks softer and more plastic than the sharper Mars terrain behind it, with a harsh cutout lit patch and jagged shadow edge inside Stickney crater plus slight aliasing along the lit upper-left silhouette
issues.fix: increase subdivision displacement and fine regolith micro-detail on Phobos to match or exceed background sharpness, smooth the crater shadow geometry, and anti-alias the moon silhouette

issues.where: lit left and upper limb and north polar cap (image-02.png crops B, D; image-03.png crops K, L; image-04.png crop U)
issues.what: the solid globe edge meets the blue atmospheric glow in a hard, slightly stair-stepped bright rim line, and the white polar cap edge shows slight pixel stair-stepping
issues.fix: soften optical limb extinction across the horizon edge and apply higher supersampling to the planet silhouette and polar ice mask

issues.where: Milky Way background sky on the left and right (image-02.png crops B, H, I; image-03.png crops J, R)
issues.what: the nebula background plate shows soft, slightly blocky blotches and multi-pixel blobby star clusters beneath the sharper point stars
issues.fix: replace or clean up the background Milky Way plate at native resolution so nebula dust and faint star clusters are free of upscaling blotches and blobby stars

issues.what: the white ice and the terrain under it are smeared along one diagonal, while the stars beside the limb stay sharp
issues.fix: rebuild that ice and limb terrain without the directional stretch, at the same sharpness as the canyon

issues.where: crop E, polar ice on the limb
issues.what: at native size the ice and surface are parallel diagonal streaks; the starfield in the same crop is not
issues.fix: replace the stretched polar texture so the ice holds up at native size

issues.where: crops U and V, polar ice at the limb
issues.what: the bright ice is stretched and streaked into the limb
issues.fix: resample the polar cap without radial stretch and match the sharper cratered terrain in crop T
